lines: Consciousness one indeed full, from removal of knowledge-difference; so indeed of breath-movement in not-rising-of-new being.
l4.sanskrit_cite: saṃvidekaiva pūrṇā syājjñānabhedavyapohanāt tathā hi prāṇacārasya navasyānudaye sati
